name: Fitness Factory
address: 67VX+24M - 2C St - Al Karama - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Athulya Alingal
reviews.text:
I've been going to Gym for 3 months as of now,  I’ve had a really positive experience training with Amal. He is a very dedicated and professional instructor who genuinely cares about helping people improve. I really appreciate the way he explains exercises clearly, pays attension and makes sure I’m training safely and correctly.

He is also very approachable and encouraging. He knows how to motivate me while still understanding my individual needs and limitations.

I’m very happy to have Amal as my instructor and would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, supportive, and responsible coach.

Overall great Gym , good atmosphere, nice people would recommend it to everyone.

reviews.author: Mohammed Firoz
reviews.text: Great budget-friendly gym in Karama with good equipment and professional trainers. Friendly staff, clean facilities, and excellent value for money. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Blessy Lorance
reviews.text:
I’ve been going to this gym for the past few months, and I’ve had a really positive experience so far. The gym has a great atmosphere and a friendly environment❤️

I would like to extend a special thank you to Coach Mr. Amal for the excellent support he has provided throughout my fitness journey. Knowledgeable and patience , he always ensures that I perform my exercises correctly. His guidance and encouragement have helped me stay consistent and maintain my motivation😊

Overall, I’m very happy with this gym and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good place to work out with supportive trainers.😊❤️

reviews.author: Drisya jagadil
reviews.text: Joining this gym has been one of the best decisions I've made. The trainers are supportive, the atmosphere is motivating, and every workout leaves me feeling stronger and more confident. I highly recommend this gym to anyone looking for a positive fitness journey.

reviews.author: ARAVIND RAVI
reviews.text: I’ve been working out at this gym for the last 5 months, and I’m extremely happy with my experience. The equipment is excellent, the gym is well maintained, and the trainers are very supportive. Special mention to Vishnu, who has been guiding my personal training throughout. From my overall experience, this is the best gym in Karama.

reviews.author: Muhammed Yoonus
reviews.text: Great gym with a friendly atmosphere and good equipment. A special thanks to my trainer, Niyas, for his support and motivation. He is professional, encouraging, and always helps me stay focused on my fitness goals. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Varsha Satish
reviews.text:
A really good mixed gym in Karama with affordable fees. The gym equips with good quality machines and certified trainers for your fitness needs starting from beginner level. The gym has a good and decent crowd for ladies as well.

Highly recommend Fitness Factory gym for your fitness needs and their certified personal trainers are always there for your help and support.
